title: QuantitativeValue
description: A structured value representing a measurement and its unit of measure. This object is a slightly modified version of the schema.org definition at https://schema.org/QuantitativeValue

maxValue.description: The maximum value of a range of measured values

minValue.description: The minimum value of a range of measured values

qualityControl.description: For values in observation records, the quality control flag from the MADIS system. The definitions of these flags can be found at https://madis.ncep.noaa.gov/madis_sfc_qc_notes.shtml
